data.rationale: The proposal has the right goal, the right order and the right five parameters, but it adds "Open Book tab" and "Continue", which aren't in the true workflow. It also leaves out details such as typing into the autocomplete and clicking the suggestion, and it doesn't say how passenger counts and cabin are set. A builder would have to guess those, so it isn't fully automatable from the spec alone.
